fib: ______ is an essential concealment of a customary law marriage.
bride price
The bride price is an essential concealment of a customary law marriage.
______ is a hybrid being neither valid nor void.
irregular marriage
An irregular marriage is a hybrid being neither valid nor void.
______ is a name for what a spouse enjoys by virtue of a bundle of rights, some of which are hardly capable of precise definition.
Consortium
Consortium is a name for what a spouse enjoys by virtue of a bundle of rights, some of which are hardly capable of precise definition.
______ is a Federal Court, a superior court of record, established on October 1, 1976 by the Constitution (Amendment) (No.2) Act.
present Court of Appeal
The present Court of Appeal is a Federal Court, a superior court of record, established on October 1, 1976 by the Constitution (Amendment) (No.2) Act 1976.
______ is an essential requirement of a valid customary law marriage.
Consent
Consent is an essential requirement of a valid customary law marriage.
______ is regarded at law as a valid and subsisting one until it is set aside by a decree of a competent court.
voidable marriage
A voidable marriage is regarded at law as a valid and subsisting one until it is set aside by a decree of a competent court.
______ means insanity, it involves the incapacity of a person to manage himself and his affairs.
Unsoundness of mind
Unsoundness of mind means insanity, it involves the incapacity of a person to manage himself and his affairs.
______ is the term that denotes a party's permanent home.
Domicile
Domicile is the term that denotes a party's permanent home.
______ is a prima facie evidence of adultery.
Bigamy
Bigamy is a prima facie evidence of adultery.
______ may be defined as a voluntary union for life of one man with two or more wives.
polygamous marriage
A polygamous marriage may be defined as a voluntary union for life of one man with two or more wives.
______ is responsible for appeals emanating from a number of Area Courts within its locality.
Upper Area Court
An Upper Area Court is responsible for appeals emanating from a number of Area Courts within its locality.
______ is a contract between a man and a woman to marry each other on a specific or determinable date.
engagement
An engagement is a contract between a man and a woman to marry each other on a specific or determinable date.
______ is concerned with the law regulating the affairs of the family and family property.
Family law
Family law is concerned with the law regulating the affairs of the family and family property.
______ may be defined as the voluntary sexual intercourse between a spouse and a third party of the opposite sex not being the husband or wife during the subsistence of the marriage.
Adultery
Adultery may be defined as the voluntary sexual intercourse between a spouse and a third party of the opposite sex not being the husband or wife during the subsistence of the marriage.
